about: AGT Food and Ingredients Inc. operates as a processor, manufacturer, and supplier of plant-based ingredients, pulses, grains, and staple foods, offering value-added food products and ingredients for retail and food industry customers. The company provides plant-based ingredients such as flours, proteins, fibres, starches, and deflavoured flours, which can be sold individually or blended for specific food applications. It offers extruded products including texturized plant protein, gluten-free pasta, and plant-based meal kits under various brands, and supplies cleaned and packaged pulses, grains, specialty crops, cereals, canned pulses, rice, milled wheat, bulgur wheat, and international food staples. The company operates retail brands that offer pasta, dairy products, dried fruit, nuts, confectionery, oils, vinegars, frozen vegetables, ready-to-eat meals, gourmet specialties, canned foods, and popcorn. Additional services include co-packing, custom product mixes, private label production, mixed container shipments, bulk grain handling, transloading facilities, and a short track railway network for crop transportation. The company serves food markets, food companies, retail stores, hospitality markets, bakery sectors, producers, and bulk grain handlers in agricultural regions. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Regina, Canada. AGT Food and Ingredients Inc. was formerly a subsidiary of Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited.
